newsitem.title: BELGIUM: No reason why France would miss EMU - de Silguy.
newsitem.headline: No reason why France would miss EMU - de Silguy.

text.p: The European Union's Economic Affairs Commissioner Yves Thibault de Silguy said on Tuesday there was no reason to fear that France will not be ready to take part in the EU's economic and monetary union, following the recent change in government.

"There is no reason to consider that the country will not be ready. The economic situation is improving, growth is increasing," de Silguy's spokesman quoted him as saying during a meeting with Italian reporters.

Commenting on the French situation in reply to a question from one of the Italian reporters, de Silguy referred to assurances given by new French Prime Minister Lionel Jospin before parliament that the euro would see the light of day and that the calendar would be met. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
